title: Capability evidence keyed by exact model revision without changing existing CAP ids
summary: The roadmap asks the capability registry to track exact model/version/revision combinations. CAP ids hash KEY_FIELDS, so adding a key field would re-id every existing record. Instead the model component of the key becomes 'model@<revision[:12]>' only when an observation carries model_revision; unrevised observations aggregate exactly as before (same ids). capability.record_observation fills a missing model_revision from the provider's registry profile (profile.revision), which covers every caller including the protected eval harness without editing it; delegate also passes selection.profile.revision explicitly. Registry profiles already normalize 'revision'; router selections now expose it; `orchestrate model-add --revision <sha>` records the served revision (e.g. the Research Radar catalog sha). Two revisions of the same model now produce separate CAP records, so a re-quantized or updated checkpoint cannot inherit its predecessor's evidence.
